title: Product formula for the AND function
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every binary vector $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the AND function on $x$ equals the product of all its coordinates: $\operatorname{AND}(x)=\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}x_i$.
